# Parkinson's disease — disease-modification research

> 8 concept packs from the research run on disease-modification research (GLP-1 agonists, LRRK2, GBA1, anti-alpha-synuclein, mitophagy, neuroinflammation and lessons from failed trials); 113 of the family's 1,155 claims are grouped under this section in llms-facts.txt. Educational research reference, not medical advice.
> Source: research run parkinson-s-disease-modification-research-glp-1-agonists-lrrk2-gba1-anti-alpha-synuclein-mitophagy-neuroinflammation-and-lessons-from-failed-trials · Generated: 2026-11-27 by llms-deep-optimizer v1.2.1 · Mode: family

## Concept packs

- [Run-level pack: Disease-modification research](https://llmsx.org/tree/parkinson-s-disease-modification-research-glp-1-agonists-lrrk2-gba1-anti-alpha-synuclein-mitophagy-neuroinflammation-and-lessons-from-failed-trials/): Run-level pack covering GLP-1 agonists, LRRK2, GBA1, anti-alpha-synuclein, mitophagy, neuroinflammation and lessons from failed trials
- [Alpha-synuclein aggregation inhibitors and buntanetap](https://llmsx.org/tree/alpha-synuclein-aggregation-inhibitors-and-buntanetap/): Buntanetap's Phase 3 early-PD study did not meet its primary endpoint per the paper and Alzforum; its cognition findings are post hoc
- [Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines](https://llmsx.org/tree/anti-alpha-synuclein-immunotherapy-prasinezumab-and-vaccines/): Prasinezumab binds aggregated alpha-synuclein; its PADOVA trial in early-stage Parkinson's disease did not meet the primary endpoint
- [Disease-modification trial landscape and lessons from failed trials](https://llmsx.org/tree/disease-modification-trial-landscape-and-lessons-from-failed-trials/): Recent reviews state that no disease-modifying therapy for Parkinson's disease has been established
- [GBA1, ambroxol and lysosomal-targeted therapies](https://llmsx.org/tree/gba1-ambroxol-and-lysosomal-targeted-therapies/): Three later randomised trials reported no benefit on their primary outcomes
- [GLP-1 agonists and drug repurposing in PD](https://llmsx.org/tree/glp-1-agonists-and-drug-repurposing-in-pd/): The larger exenatide phase 3 trial reported no evidence of disease modification at 96 weeks
- [LRRK2-targeted therapies: small molecule and antisense](https://llmsx.org/tree/lrrk2-targeted-therapies-small-molecule-and-antisense/): Biogen and Denali report that the Phase 2b LUMA study of BIIB122 in early-stage Parkinson’s disease did not meet its primary or secondary endpoints
- [Mitochondrial and mitophagy targets: PINK1, parkin, USP30](https://llmsx.org/tree/mitochondrial-and-mitophagy-targets-pink1-parkin-usp30/): PINK1 activators such as MTK458 are earlier-stage, and a Science Advances paper reports PINK1/Parkin-independent off-target effects for two activators
- [Neuroinflammation: NLRP3 and microglia targets](https://llmsx.org/tree/neuroinflammation-nlrp3-and-microglia-targets/): Minocycline and azathioprine did not meet efficacy goals, and a review says selecting participants by inflammatory phenotype could potentially enhance success

## Top sources, live-checked 2026-11-27

- [pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39919773 (6 claims in this run)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39919773/): A Lancet Expression of Concern now qualifies the published exenatide disease-modification trial
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11492043 (4 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11492043/): Reviews report that α-synuclein can drive NLRP3 inflammasome activation in microglia, and that inflammasome activation releases pro-inflammatory cytokines
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6990847 (4 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6990847/): In the open-label Mullin trial, the authors report that CSF GCase activity decreased by 19% while CSF α-synuclein concentration increased by 13%
- [pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38598572 (4 claims in this run)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38598572/): In the phase 2 lixisenatide trial, the authors report nausea in 46% and vomiting in 13% of participants receiving lixisenatide
- [pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41876647 (4 claims in this run)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41876647/): REASON participant numbers differ by source: the paper abstract reports 40 participants in part A and 42 in part B
- [nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x (4 claims in this run)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44400-026-00148-x): The original primary endpoint of the buntanetap early-PD study was the sum of MDS-UPDRS Part II and Part III
- [missiontherapeutics.com/mission-therapeutics-doses-first-parkinsons-pati (3 claims in this run)](https://missiontherapeutics.com/mission-therapeutics-doses-first-parkinsons-patient-in-phase-1b-study-of-potential-disease-modifying-treatment-mtx325/): Mission Therapeutics announced that the first patient has been dosed in its Phase 1b proof-of-mechanism study of MTX325
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12916515 (3 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12916515/): The ASPro-PD protocol reports that approximately 10–15% of individuals with PD carry a GBA1 variant
